meta.title: A reversed window on a started round is refused by the "already started" rule first

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot re-schedule this event!”, and never with a server error.
